name: comp-295

frames.best_why: The card is largest and unobstructed, showing the photo, both names, the timestamp and both buttons clearly.

tagline: A tiny profile photo precedes the line naming who mentioned you and where.
summary: A mention notification card. A round avatar sits beside a sentence with the person and project in bold, a timestamp below, and Accept and Decline buttons at the foot.
appearance: A bordered rounded card with a soft shadow holds a circular photo at the left, then pale text with two bold names, a small grey timestamp, a light filled Accept button and a darker outlined Decline button. A grey X sits at the top right.
behaviour: Hovering either bold name underlines it and the close cross brightens on hover. Pressing Accept, Decline or the cross does nothing because no handlers are attached.
demo_content: Mary Palmer is said to have mentioned you in project-campaign-02, two minutes ago.
use_when: A specific person is named in a mention and the reader can accept or decline on the spot.
avoid_when: The avatar, names and time are hardcoded, and neither decision is wired to anything.
customise: The avatar URL, names, timestamp and button labels are written into the file; there are no props and the width cap is fixed.
weight_why: One small photo, a short paragraph and two buttons.

a11y.note: The photo has alt text and the close is named, but Accept and Decline are not wired to any action.

issues: Accept, Decline and the close cross have no handlers, so none of them responds.
Both name links point at an empty hash and lead nowhere.
polish_why: Warm, readable card with a clear person-plus-context line; buttons are the loose end.
search_phrases: someone mentioned you in a project
accept or decline a request card
message that names a person and a board
invite asking to join a workspace
title: Social Mention Notification
